title: Static Image & Multipage Export
objective: Export panel/page images and deterministic multipage comic packages at governed output profiles while filtering prohibited transforms, export and redistribution rights before render/export.
acceptance: Panel and page export requests preserve stable SAA project/page/panel identity and explicit output-profile identity.
Multipage export preserves explicit governed page/panel sequence rather than inferring order from layout coordinates or filesystem order.
Output format, dimensions, locale/reading direction and other governed output-profile metadata are explicit and deterministic.
ARI rights/use capability checks occur before render/export; prohibited transform, export or redistribution states fail closed without fabricated permission.
Export consumes permitted SAA/ARI references without mutating project history, ARI source resources, Character/Scene/narrative truth or derivative provenance.
Provider-off local static image and package export remains supported; optional AI and paid cloud are not required.
SAA-16 and later audio/share/publication/SMB10B behavior remain unauthorized.
boundaries: SAA-15 owns static image and deterministic multipage package export only; ARI retains resource/provenance/rights authority.
Export filtering may reject prohibited output but may not rewrite rights state, owner truth, SAA history or source assets.
No audio cue lane, sharing/publication, final Creator integration or automatic semantic rewriting authority is granted.
SAA-16 remains blocked until verified SAA-15 closeout.
next_action: SAA-15 is completed_verified. SAA-16 — Optional Digital-Comic Audio Cue Lane — is selected_not_started without implementation authority.
